format: html
params:

```{python}
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

subject = params["subject"]
export_dir = Path(params["export_dir"])
metrics = json.loads((export_dir / f"{subject}_metrics.json").read_text())
directions = pd.read_csv(export_dir / f"{subject}_directions.csv")
sliding = pd.read_csv(export_dir / f"{subject}_sliding_dci.csv")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
```

## Metrics

```{python}
metrics
```

## Direction distributions

```{r}
dirs <- read.csv(file.path(params$export_dir, paste0(params$subject, "_directions.csv")))
ggplot(dirs, aes(x = direction_rad, fill = condition)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 36, position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_polar() +
  facet_wrap(~condition, nrow = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("Direction rose plots:", params$subject), x = "Direction (rad)", y = "Count")
```

## Sliding DCI

```{r}
slide <- read.csv(file.path(params$export_dir, paste0(params$subject, "_sliding_dci.csv")))
ggplot(slide, aes(x = time_s, y = dci, color = condition)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("Sliding DCI:", params$subject), x = "Time (s)", y = "DCI")
```
